description: V0.4-08-FIX-1 governance closure: the single Replay-project-authority remediation delivered by Sub-Agent C on the joint staging tree fix/v0.4-wave1-fix1-staging.

tasks.title: Replay Project Authority Closure
tasks.objective: ReplaySession.open() must stop bypassing the CAN-X project authority. Today the production entry point is ReplaySession.open() -> _resolve_data_session() -> Path.is_dir() -> DataSessionService.get_session(), which is NOT full CAN-X project validation. The authority is ProjectService().open(), which validates the path, project.json presence, the manifest, project.db presence, the database schema, manifest/database identity agreement and the supported project version. Change the production entry so it FIRST calls ProjectService().open(Path(project_root)); only after full project validation succeeds may it build DataSessionService / QueryService / SessionReplaySource from handle.root. The ProjectHandle must be closed correctly. Do NOT copy ProjectService validation into the replay package, do NOT read project.json directly, do NOT compare project_id by hand, do NOT validate the SQLite schema by hand. Project-domain failures must be translated into the typed ReplayProjectError with a stable cause code (e.g. replay.project_unavailable with details.cause = project.manifest_missing / project.database_missing / project.identity_mismatch / ...), never leaking raw SQLite exceptions, tracebacks, secrets or absolute host-specific internals.
tasks.scope: The replay package's project-entry path and its tests, plus the V0.4-08 acceptance document.
non_goals: Any change to runtime/canx/query/**, runtime/canx/data/**, runtime/canx/dbc/** (read-only)
Any real CAN TX, python-can TX, CanAdapter.send, Safety authorization or ARM state
Reimplementing project validation inside the replay package
acceptance_criteria: ReplaySession.open() calls ProjectService().open(Path(project_root)) on the production entry before any DataSession/Query construction
A missing project.json is REFUSED (RED first: the current implementation wrongly accepts it)
A project_id mismatch between manifest and database yields ReplayProjectError with the corresponding Project cause
An unsupported project version keeps the same authority as the Project domain
Project-domain failures are translated to the typed ReplayProjectError with a stable cause code and no raw SQLite exception / traceback / secret / absolute host path leak
No project validation is re-implemented inside the replay package
All V0.4-08 replay regression stays green (deterministic timing, fake clock, ordering, pagination boundedness, frame fidelity, CAN FD/BRS/ESI, cancellation, sink/query failures, offline-only no-TX)
handoff_requirements: RED evidence first: the R1/R2/R3 tests failing against the pre-fix implementation, with real output
Exact commands and results for pytest tests/unit/replay, tests/integration/test_offline_replay.py, tests/performance/test_replay_bounded_memory.py, ruff on the replay surface, and mypy runtime
State explicitly that runtime/canx/project/**, runtime/canx/query/**, runtime/canx/data/**, runtime/canx/safety/** and runtime/canx/devices/** are untouched
The negative no-TX assertion still holds
